# Handoff Playback

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Hands off Current Audio.

## Syntax

~~~~text
handoffPlayback(source: <#Variable#>, route: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
handoffPlayback(source: ShortcutInput, route: iPhone)
~~~~
